# QuoteGauge

> QuoteGauge is a web tool that checks whether a car repair, home repair or contractor quote is fair. A person adds the quote (photo, PDF or typed lines) with a US ZIP code, plus the vehicle for car repairs or the trade for home work. QuoteGauge estimates a fair price range for every line and marks each one fair, above market or needs verification.

## Key facts

- What it does: estimates fair price ranges for car repair, home repair and contractor quotes in the United States (HVAC, roofing, plumbing, electrical, appliance, remodeling, landscaping, pest control, moving, auto body).
- Inputs: the quote, vehicle year/make/model, ZIP code, and whether the shop is independent, a dealership or a national chain.
- Output: an overall verdict, the likely overcharge in dollars, a rating for each line, items that may not be needed, and a script for talking to the shop.
- Products and prices: Repair Quote Checker ($4.99) prices one estimate line by line; Repair Quote Comparator ($14.99) compares up to five estimates for the same repair and recommends the best value; Repair Necessity Checker ($9.99) explains recommended repairs and sorts them by urgency; Any Quote Checker ($9.99) prices home repair and contractor quotes line by line. The first answer on each is free. Single reports are one-time purchases with no account; Check Any Quote Unlimited ($26/month, cancel anytime) is the main plan: unlimited full reports for car, home and contractor quotes. Single reports are refunded within 7 days if not useful.
- Method: AI estimates built from standard labor times, typical parts cost and typical regional labor rates for the type of shop.
- Rating rule: a line is "above market" when it is more than 10% over the top of its fair range, and "needs verification" when it cannot be judged without seeing the car.
- Limits: it is an estimate, not an inspection. It cannot see the car's condition or the grade of parts quoted. Collision and body work is covered by the Any Quote Checker; insurance claim estimates are not covered.
- Independence: QuoteGauge takes no referral fees or commissions from repair shops, dealerships, contractors or parts sellers.
- Privacy: quotes are analysed and not stored by QuoteGauge after the report is produced.

## Cost guides (fair 2026 US price ranges, with sources)

- [All repair and home job costs](https://quotegauge.pro/repair-costs)
- [Brake pad replacement cost](https://quotegauge.pro/cost/brake-pad-replacement-cost): Brake pad replacement usually costs $150 to $400 per axle in 2026. See what is included, what pushes the price up, and the add-ons to question.
- [Brake pads and rotors cost](https://quotegauge.pro/cost/brake-pads-and-rotors-cost): New brake pads and rotors usually cost $250 to $600 per axle at an independent shop in 2026. Here is how to tell if your quote is fair.
- [Alternator replacement cost](https://quotegauge.pro/cost/alternator-replacement-cost): Alternator replacement usually costs $400 to $900 in 2026, parts and labor. See remanufactured vs new pricing and what to check first.
- [Starter replacement cost](https://quotegauge.pro/cost/starter-replacement-cost): Starter replacement usually costs $350 to $650 at an independent shop in 2026 and more at a dealer. Here is what drives the price.
- [Water pump replacement cost](https://quotegauge.pro/cost/water-pump-replacement-cost): A water pump replacement usually costs $400 to $1,100 in 2026. Timing-belt-driven pumps cost more. Here is how to read your quote.
- [Timing belt replacement cost](https://quotegauge.pro/cost/timing-belt-replacement-cost): Timing belt replacement usually costs $500 to $1,300 in 2026, more with a water pump. See what a full kit includes and how to compare quotes.
- [Car battery replacement cost](https://quotegauge.pro/cost/car-battery-replacement-cost): A new 12-volt car battery usually costs $150 to $350 installed in 2026. AGM batteries cost more. Here is how to avoid overpaying.
- [Car AC recharge cost](https://quotegauge.pro/cost/car-ac-recharge-cost): A car AC recharge costs about $150 to $300 for R-134a and $250 to $550 for R-1234yf in 2026. See what you should be charged for.
- [Catalytic converter replacement cost](https://quotegauge.pro/cost/catalytic-converter-replacement-cost): Catalytic converter replacement usually costs $1,000 to $3,000 in 2026, more for luxury cars and California-compliant parts. Check this before you pay.
- [Wheel alignment cost](https://quotegauge.pro/cost/wheel-alignment-cost): A four-wheel alignment costs about $90 to $160 at chain shops in 2026; dealers charge more. Here is when an alignment is actually needed.
- [Spark plug replacement cost](https://quotegauge.pro/cost/spark-plug-replacement-cost): Spark plug replacement costs about $100 to $250 on a 4-cylinder and $165 to $400 on a V6 in 2026. See why some quotes are much higher.
- [Serpentine belt replacement cost](https://quotegauge.pro/cost/serpentine-belt-replacement-cost): A serpentine belt replacement usually costs $100 to $250 in 2026. With a tensioner, $150 to $400. Here is what to expect.
- [Oxygen sensor replacement cost](https://quotegauge.pro/cost/oxygen-sensor-replacement-cost): An oxygen sensor replacement usually costs $150 to $500 per sensor in 2026. Upstream sensors cost more. Here is how to check your quote.
- [Radiator replacement cost](https://quotegauge.pro/cost/radiator-replacement-cost): A radiator replacement usually costs $300 to $1,000 in 2026 at an independent shop. See what is included and what to question.
- [Transmission fluid change cost](https://quotegauge.pro/cost/transmission-fluid-change-cost): A transmission drain-and-fill costs about $80 to $250 in 2026; a flush costs about $150 to $400. Here is which one you need.
- [Central AC replacement cost](https://quotegauge.pro/cost/ac-replacement-cost): Replacing a central air conditioner usually costs $4,000 to $9,500 installed in 2026 with existing ducts. Here is how to compare HVAC quotes.
- [Furnace replacement cost](https://quotegauge.pro/cost/furnace-replacement-cost): A new gas furnace usually costs $3,800 to $10,000 installed in 2026; electric furnaces cost less. Here is how to read a furnace quote.
- [Water heater replacement cost](https://quotegauge.pro/cost/water-heater-replacement-cost): A tank water heater replacement usually costs $900 to $2,500 installed in 2026; tankless costs $1,400 to $3,900. Here is what a fair quote includes.
- [Roof replacement cost](https://quotegauge.pro/cost/roof-replacement-cost): An asphalt shingle roof replacement usually costs $8,000 to $16,000 in 2026, or about $4 to $8 per square foot. Here is how to compare roofing quotes.
- [AC capacitor replacement cost](https://quotegauge.pro/cost/ac-capacitor-replacement-cost): An AC capacitor replacement usually costs $150 to $400 in 2026, including the service call. The part itself is often under $75.
